name: Rosette
author: Trance
description: Six flowers one inside another, three petals to twelve, turning against each other. Each opens and thickens with its own range, from the rumble outside to the shimmer at the heart.
frame:
s0 = s0 + dt*0.15*(0.3 + sub_att)
s1 = s1 + dt*-0.15*(0.3 + low_att)
s2 = s2 + dt*0.15*(0.3 + lowmid_att)
s3 = s3 + dt*-0.15*(0.3 + highmid_att)
s4 = s4 + dt*0.15*(0.3 + presence_att)
s5 = s5 + dt*-0.15*(0.3 + air_att)

layers.point:
th = t*tau
rr = 0.92*(0.7 + 0.3*cos(3*th))*(0.75 + 0.25*sub_att) + v*0.025
x = rr*cos(th + s0)
y = rr*sin(th + s0)

th = t*tau
rr = 0.78*(0.7 + 0.3*cos(4*th))*(0.75 + 0.25*low_att) + v*0.025
x = rr*cos(th + s1)
y = rr*sin(th + s1)

th = t*tau
rr = 0.64*(0.7 + 0.3*cos(5*th))*(0.75 + 0.25*lowmid_att) + v*0.025
x = rr*cos(th + s2)
y = rr*sin(th + s2)

th = t*tau
rr = 0.5*(0.7 + 0.3*cos(6*th))*(0.75 + 0.25*highmid_att) + v*0.025
x = rr*cos(th + s3)
y = rr*sin(th + s3)

th = t*tau
rr = 0.36*(0.7 + 0.3*cos(8*th))*(0.75 + 0.25*presence_att) + v*0.025
x = rr*cos(th + s4)
y = rr*sin(th + s4)

th = t*tau
rr = 0.22*(0.7 + 0.3*cos(12*th))*(0.75 + 0.25*air_att) + v*0.025
x = rr*cos(th + s5)
y = rr*sin(th + s5)
